plan: A very long-range marksman support who grows stronger and stronger by collecting souls.
aSurveiller: Her W (Last Embrace). It latches onto you then roots you: move away from allies who got hit.
contrer: Stay behind your minions: her W latches onto the first one hit.
Engage her: she is very fragile.
Her R crosses the map: when low on health, take cover.

sorts.Q: Beam that heals her allies and damages.
sorts.E: Camouflage for her and her allies.
